# Exercise library coverage and the Amendment 15 reconciliation

<!-- GENERATED by deploy/exercise_library_additions.py --write-doc — do not hand-edit (epic #5861, lane L2). -->

Comprehensive library, selective engine: this page lists what the library covers, what lane L2 added, and the outcome for every candidate. A movement in the library is **available**, not prescribed: the selection engine picks 4-8 per session, and only while the library is approved.

**ADD vs VARIANT rule.** A candidate becomes an ADD only when it serves a muscle or movement function nothing in the library serves (or serves only with something that cannot be loaded or progressed). A grip, stance, range, tempo, laterality, plane or equipment change of a served function is a VARIANT of that canonical, even when Hevy has its own template for it; regressions and progressions are VARIANT levels. IDs and history are never touched.

**Prescribable.** An ADD with a Hevy template (built-in, or a custom template already in the account) can be logged; one without needs a custom template the owner approves first. Either way the selection engine also needs a movement-catalog entry before it can write the movement.

**Evidence.** No citation is invented. Each addition's categorical inputs are practitioner-consensus judgements; the library's per-objective rubric turns them into the tiers shown (no trial claimed; hypertrophy rows stay `none_reviewed`).
